'''Jac al'Seen''' is a farmer from the [[Two Rivers]].

== Appearance ==
He is stocky and square-shouldered, with less hair than [[Brandelwyn al'Vere]]. What hair he does have is gray. He is almost the twin of his cousin Wit.{{ref/book|4|32}}

== History ==
The al'Seen farm is as large as farms go in the Two Rivers, with three tall barns and five [[tabac]] curing sheds.{{ref/book|4|32}}

He is married to [[Elisa al'Seen]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Jac al'Seen}} 

His son is [[Ban al'Seen|Ban]] and his cousin is [[Wit al'Seen|Wit]]. He is part of the larger [[al'Seen]] clan.


== Activities ==
When Trollocs appeared in the Two Rivers, he provided safety for many of his neighbours at his large farm, including the families of his cousin Wit and of [[Flann Lewin]] and [[Natley Lewin]]. [[Tamlin al'Thor|Tam al'Thor]] says he is a good man.{{ref/book|4|32}} 

When [[Perrin Aybara]] and his group visit their farm, Jac greets them. He tells Perrin that the Whitecloaks have been naming him a [[Darkfriend]], which they do not believe but want to know why they would accuse him of such a thing. He accepts the story Perrin gives.{{ref/book|4|32}} 

After listening to Lord [[Luc]]'s advice, Jac and his family take Perrin's advice instead, which is to go to [[Emond's Field]].{{ref/book|4|33}} Jac helps defend [[Emond's Field]] against the invading [[Trolloc]] army.{{ref/book|4|56}}
